bullets.c:fire_bullet $E08C sets B_X=tank_x+dx*8; bullet_step moves it per direction (bullets.c:269-); collisions compare abs(B_X-T_X)<$0A (bullets.c:505,533); sprites.c:BULLET_X draw => bullet X pixel, [10]: slot i<8 fired by tank i, slots 8,9 = second bullet of players 0/1 (player_fire $E122 moves old bullet to x+8)

bullets.c:fire_bullet $E08C =dir|$40 only if 0; bullet_move gate (state&$F0)==$40 flying (bullets.c:269), dir=state&3; hit sets $33 (bullets.c:226,507,535), bullet_explode_tick $E076 decs, hi nibble steps down, 0=free (clear_bullet_slots $E409); sprites.c:290 anim index from state>>3 => mode(hi nibble: 4 flying, 1-3 explosion countdown, 0 free)+direction(low 2 bits), [10]

bullets.c:fire_bullet $E08C sets 0/1/3 by tank_type hi nibble ($C0->1, $60->3); bullets.c bullet-move: flags&1 => extra step (line 81, 270 fast); bullets.c:228 flags&2 => powerful wipes whole cell; player_fire $E122 copies flags to slot x+8 => bit0=fast, bit1=powerful, [10]

tanks.c:update_tank_terrain $E181 stores ptr_lo of coords_to_map($D706,x-8,y-8) per live tank; clear_tank_occupancy $E1FA reloads it as ptr_lo to unmark cells => low byte of cached terrain-map cell pointer of tank's top-left cell, [8]

tanks.c:update_tank_terrain $E181 stores ptr_hi&3, then |=$80 if tank_x&7==0 (extra cell ptr+$20 marked), |=$40 if tank_y&7==0 (ptr+$01); clear_tank_occupancy $E1FA uses (hi&3)|4 and tests bits 7/6 => high byte (&3, page offset from $0400) of cached cell pointer + flags bit7 x-on-grid, bit6 y-on-grid, [8]

sound.c:sound_reset $EA51 set_zptr($F0,$031C) then +8 per slot; sound_driver $EA7E passes 1-3 walk it; V(i)=ind_y($F0,i) reads/writes voice bytes; docs/subsystems/sound.md => low byte of 16-bit zp pointer to current 8-byte voice record in sound_voices (pair with $F1)

same as $F0: set_zptr(0xF0,VOICES) in sound_reset $EA51 / sound_driver $EA7E; +8 per slot step (sound.c:224,257); ends at $03FC after reset => high byte of voice-record pointer (sound.c V()/SETV via ($F0),y)

bullets.c:powerup_timer $E9F5 sets $0A; tanks.c:490 dec when frame_counter&$3F==0; tanks.c:499 move_all_tanks skips live enemies while !=0; bullets.c:184 enemy firing returns while !=0; flow.c:198 cleared at stage init => TIMER powerup freeze counter in 64-frame units (also gates enemy fire)

bullets.c:powerup_star $EA07 +=$20 cap $60 and copies to tank_type; tanks.c:init_tank_type $E3B8 a=player_level[x]; cleared on player death bullets.c:513 (RAM[0x101+x]=0) and on game start flow_hud.c:46 => per-player star level 0/$20/$40/$60 (also tank_type for players), [2] p1,p2

tanks.c:update_tank_terrain $E181 sets/clears bit7 by ice cell under player; player_control $DB75: bit7&&(&$1F)==0 => =$9C and sound_req[16]; bit7&&bit4 => pad ignored; tank_turning $DC52 dec while sliding and steps tank; [2] p1,p2; clear_tank_slots $E413 over-zeroes up to $010A (quirk) => ice-skid state: bit7 on ice, low 5 bits slide frame counter

sprites.c:draw_game_over_banner $C947 draws GAME at (banner_x,banner_y), OVER at x+$10; tanks.c:tank_dying $DDEA sets $C0 (p2 out) or $20 (p1 out); flow_hud.c:stage_over $C728 sets $70; game_over_slide $C972 adds tbl_banner_dx => GAME OVER banner X; no other banner uses it (PAUSE is draw_pause_banner $C8F9)

sprites.c:draw_game_over_banner $C947 uses it as Y; arm_game_over_banner $DE46 sets $D8; stage_over $C728 sets $F0 (parked off-screen, also when timer hits 0 at $C98A); game_over_slide adds tbl_banner_dy => GAME OVER banner Y

arm_game_over_banner $DE46 =$0D; stage_over $C728 =$11; game_over_slide $C972: dec every 16 frames, parks banner at y=$F0 at 0, slides only while >=$0A, 0 = idle; flow.c:512 nonzero extends stage end to phase_timer=$FE => GAME OVER banner countdown/state, 0=not showing

cells.c: records [addr_hi,addr_lo,data..,$FF] appended at vram_queue_len ($0C); gfx_text.c:flush_vram_queue $D8FD writes them to $2006/$2007 in NMI and resets len; index wraps at 256 so overflow runs into $0200 (cells.c vq_put) => VRAM update queue; ram.h says [128] but index is 8-bit, lies in the stack page
sprites.c:64-67 writes Y,tile,attr,X at $0200+oam_index; gfx_text.c:clear_oam $DA93 fills $F0; CLAUDE.md: NMI $D400 does OAM DMA from page $02 => 256-byte sprite shadow copied to OAM each NMI
